-- Credits (10001-10099): +1 on both balances INSERT INTO minicore.transaction_code_balance_effects (transaction_code, balance_name, effect) SELECT tc.transaction_code, b.balance_name, 1 FROM minicore.transaction_codes tc CROSS JOIN minicore.balances b WHERE tc.transaction_code BETWEEN 10001 AND 10099;
-- Debits (20001-20099) and Fees (30001-30099): -1 on both balances INSERT INTO minicore.transaction_code_balance_effects (transaction_code, balance_name, effect) SELECT tc.transaction_code, b.balance_name, -1 FROM minicore.transaction_codes tc CROSS JOIN minicore.balances b WHERE tc.transaction_code BETWEEN 20001 AND 30099
